levels.cannotCheck: Couldn't check official warnings right now

rain_heavy.orange: Keep a torch, charger and medicines ready; avoid travel if possible.
rain_heavy.red: Stay indoors; follow district instructions; call 112 in an emergency.

thunder.yellow: Go indoors when you hear thunder.
thunder.orange: Avoid open fields, trees and water bodies.

heat.orange: Avoid outdoor work from 12 to 4 PM.
heat.red: Check on elderly people and children; watch for heat stroke signs.

cold.red: Avoid early morning travel; use heaters safely with ventilation.

fog.orange: Use low beam and fog lights; allow extra travel time.

cyclone.red: Move to a shelter if told to; call 112.

health.satisfactory: Minor breathing discomfort to sensitive people.
health.moderate: Breathing discomfort to people with lung disease such as asthma, and discomfort to people with heart disease, children and older adults.
health.poor: Breathing discomfort to most people on prolonged exposure.
health.severe: Affects healthy people and seriously impacts those with existing diseases.

umbrella.headline: Carry an umbrella after {{time}}
umbrella.why: Shown because hourly rain chance reaches 60% or more, with at least 0.5 mm, in the next 12 hours.

heavyRainSoon.headline: Heavy rain expected from {{time}}; avoid low-lying roads
heavyRainSoon.why: Shown because the forecast has 15.6 mm or more of rain within 3 hours.

heat.headline: It will feel like {{hi}}°C from {{time}}; stay in shade and drink water
heat.why: Shown because the heat index reaches 41°C or more in daytime hours.

warmNight.headline: Hot night ahead; keep rooms ventilated and drink water before bed
warmNight.why: Shown because tonight's minimum is 30°C or more.

cold.headline: Cold morning ({{tmin}}°C); layer up and protect the elderly
cold.why: Shown because the minimum temperature is 10°C or lower.

fog.headline: Fog {{start}} to {{end}}; drive slow with low beam
fog.why: Shown because visibility is forecast below 500 m in the next 12 hours.

lightning.headline: Thunderstorm likely by {{time}}; plan to be indoors
lightning.why: Shown because a thunderstorm is forecast, or its chance is 40% or more, in the next 3 hours.

dust.headline: Dusty winds today; wear a mask outdoors
dust.reason: PM10 {{pm10}} µg/m³ with gusts of {{gust}} km/h
dust.why: Shown because PM10 is above 250 and wind gusts are above 35 km/h.

aqiPoor.headline: Air is {{category}} (AQI {{aqi}}); limit long outdoor activity
aqiPoor.why: Shown because the air quality index is 201 or more (Poor or worse).

aqiSevere.headline: Severe air; stay indoors where possible
aqiSevere.why: Shown because the air quality index is 401 or more (Severe).

goodEvening.headline: Pleasant evening ahead; good time for a walk after {{time}}
goodEvening.reason: About {{tempC}}°C, comfortable air and no rain
goodEvening.why: Shown because no important tip fired today and evening conditions score 75 or more for comfort.

bestTimeOut.headline: Best time to step out: {{start}} to {{end}}
bestTimeOut.reason: Cleanest air and most comfortable heat of the day (score {{score}})
bestTimeOut.why: Shown because this 2-hour block has the best outdoor comfort score, weighing air quality, heat, UV and rain.

uvHigh.headline: UV will be {{category}} ({{uv}}) {{start}} to {{end}}; cover up
uvHigh.reason: Use shade, a cap, sunglasses and SPF 30+ sunscreen
uvHigh.why: Shown because the UV index reaches 8 or more.

humid.headline: Very humid {{start}} to {{end}}; damp air can trigger breathing and skin issues
humid.reason: Humidity 85% or more for at least 3 hours
humid.why: Shown because you noted asthma or skin sensitivity and humidity stays at 85% or more for 3 hours or longer.

allergyHigh.headline: Allergy risk may be high today (estimate)
allergyHigh.reason: Estimate. India does not have public pollen counts yet. Based on season, dust (PM10) and wind.
allergyHigh.why: Shown because you noted allergies and the season, dust and wind together point to high risk.

sensitiveAqi.headline: Air is {{category}}; keep medicines handy and avoid exertion outdoors
sensitiveAqi.why: Shown because you noted a sensitivity and the air quality index is 101 or more.

bestWindow.headline: Best window for your {{activity}}: {{start}} to {{end}} (score {{score}})
bestWindow.reason: Comfortable heat, clean air and no rain in this window
bestWindow.why: Shown because this is the highest Run Score block (50 or more) in your preferred time, combining heat, air, rain, wind, UV and daylight.

noSafeWindow.headline: No comfortable outdoor window today; train indoors
noSafeWindow.reason: Every hour in the next 36 scores below 50
noSafeWindow.why: Shown because no hour in the next 36 hours reaches a Run Score of 50.

headwind.headline: Strong {{dir}} wind; ride into it first
headwind.why: Shown because you cycle and gusts reach 25 km/h or more.

stayOut.headline: Do not enter the sea today
stayOut.why: Shown because an official warning is active, waves are 2 m or more, a long-period swell is running, a thunderstorm is near or gusts are 45 km/h or more.

caution.headline: Swim only near lifeguards
caution.why: Shown because waves are 1 to 2 m, the swell period is 10 s or more, wind is 25 km/h or more, or low tide raises rip risk.

goodDay.headline: Good beach day; high tide {{time}}, sunset {{sunset}}
goodDay.reason: Gentle sea and no rain; UV {{uv}}, carry shade
goodDay.why: Shown because the sea verdict is Safe and no rain is expected.

noGo.headline: Not safe to go to sea
noGo.why: Shown because IMD has issued a fishermen or coastal warning, or wind or waves are too strong for small boats.

window.headline: Calm sea tomorrow {{start}} to {{end}}; wind {{wind}} km/h
window.why: Shown because tomorrow early morning wind stays below 15 km/h and waves below 1 m.

fogFlight.headline: Fog at {{airport}} {{when}}; flights may be delayed, check with your airline
fogFlight.reason: This is airport weather, not flight status
fogFlight.why: Shown because your flight is within 48 hours and airport visibility is forecast below 800 m or the airport report shows fog.

destWarning.headline: {{hazard}} ({{level}}) at {{place}} on {{date}}
destWarning.reason: Official IMD warning for your trip dates
destWarning.why: Shown because IMD has a warning for your destination on your trip dates.

pack.headline: Packing tip for {{place}}: {{items}}
pack.reason: Based on the forecast for your trip dates
pack.why: Shown because your trip starts within 7 days.

hillRain.headline: Landslide risk on hill roads {{date}}; keep buffer time
hillRain.why: Shown because your destination is above 1,000 m and heavy rain (64.5 mm or more in a day) is forecast.

schoolMorning.headline: School run {{time}}: {{condition}}; {{action}}
schoolMorning.reason: Conditions at the school time you set
schoolMorning.why: Shown because at your school time rain is 40% or more, it feels 38°C or hotter, AQI is 201 or more, or visibility is below 500 m.

schoolAfternoon.headline: Pickup {{time}}: {{condition}}; {{action}}
schoolAfternoon.reason: Conditions at the school time you set
schoolAfternoon.why: Shown because at your school time rain is 40% or more, it feels 38°C or hotter, AQI is 201 or more, or visibility is below 500 m.

outdoorPlay.headline: Keep outdoor play short this evening
outdoorPlay.reason: Poor air or strong heat between 4 and 7 PM
outdoorPlay.why: Shown because AQI is 201 or more, or it feels 41°C or hotter, between 4 and 7 PM.

spray.headline: Good spraying window {{start}} to {{end}}
spray.reason: Light wind and no rain expected for 6 hours. General guidance: follow the product label and your KVK advice.
spray.why: Shown because wind is 3 to 10 km/h, no rain is expected for 6 hours, it is below 32°C and humidity is above 40%.

noSpray.headline: Don't spray today; rain likely {{when}}
noSpray.why: Shown because rain is likely within 6 hours, which would wash the spray off.

heavyRainPrep.headline: Heavy rain on {{day}} ({{mm}} mm); delay fertiliser, clear drains
heavyRainPrep.reason: IMD calls 64.5 mm or more in a day heavy rain
heavyRainPrep.why: Shown because 64.5 mm or more of rain is forecast on a day in the next 5 days.

dryIrrigate.headline: Topsoil is dry; irrigate if your crop needs it
dryIrrigate.reason: Topsoil moisture {{moisture}} m³/m³, no real rain in 3 days
dryIrrigate.why: Shown because topsoil moisture is below 0.15 and no day in the next 3 has 5 mm of rain.

frost.headline: Frost risk tonight ({{tmin}}°C); cover nurseries and young plants
frost.reason: Clear, calm nights let the ground freeze even at 2 to 4°C
frost.why: Shown because tonight's minimum is 2°C or lower, or 2 to 4°C with clear sky and light wind.

hail.headline: Hail possible {{when}}; protect seedlings and orchards
hail.reason: Thunderstorm with hail in the forecast
hail.why: Shown because the forecast includes a thunderstorm with hail.

lightningField.headline: Lightning risk this afternoon; leave open fields when thunder starts
lightningField.why: Shown because the chance of thunderstorm is 40% or more in daylight within 6 hours.

heatLivestock.headline: Keep livestock in shade with water; avoid transport in the afternoon
heatLivestock.why: Shown because the heat index reaches 41°C or more.

leave.headline: {{verdict}}
leave.why: Shown for your next saved departure time, comparing it with when rain starts and stops.

waterlogging.headline: Waterlogging reported near {{place}} {{minutes}} min ago
waterlogging.why: Shown because a verified report is within 500 m of your saved places or route in the last 3 hours.

twoWheelerHeat.headline: Very hot ride at {{time}}; cover your head, carry water
twoWheelerHeat.why: Shown because you ride a two-wheeler and it feels 41°C or hotter at a departure time.

rainRisk.headline: {{prob}}% rain chance for {{event}}; plan cover
rainRisk.why: Shown because your event is within 16 days and rain chance in its time slot is 50% or more.

wind.headline: Strong gusts for {{event}}; secure tents and decor
wind.why: Shown because gusts of 40 km/h or more are forecast in your event's time slot.

comfort.headline: {{event}}: comfort {{score}} ({{band}})
comfort.reason: Heat, humidity, rain chance, wind and air combined
comfort.why: Shown because your event is within the 16-day forecast.

climatology.headline: Historically rained on {{n}} of {{years}} years on this date
climatology.reason: Based on past years, not a forecast
climatology.why: Shown because your event is more than 16 days away, beyond the forecast.

heatDanger.headline: Dangerous heat {{start}} to {{end}}; water every 20 min, rest in shade hourly
heatDanger.reason: Feels like up to {{hi}}°C in your work hours
heatDanger.why: Shown because the heat index reaches 41°C or more during your work hours.

coolSpot.headline: Nearest cool spot: {{name}}, {{distance}}
coolSpot.reason: Public place, not a confirmed cooling centre
coolSpot.why: Shown because dangerous heat is expected and a public cool place is within 2 km.

lightning30.headline: Lightning nearby: get indoors now, wait 30 min after the last thunder
lightning30.reason: Safe places: proper buildings and hard-top vehicles with windows closed
lightning30.why: Shown because lightning struck within 10 km in the last 30 minutes, or IMD has a thunderstorm nowcast for your area.

heavyRainRiding.headline: Heavy rain {{when}}; slow down, avoid flooded underpasses
heavyRainRiding.why: Shown because you deliver and 7.6 mm or more of rain in an hour is forecast in your work hours.

official.why: Shown because IMD or NDMA has issued this warning for your area. Official warnings are shown exactly as issued.

commute.no_rain: Leave on time; no rain expected on your way
commute.leave_on_time: Leave on time; you'll beat the rain
commute.wait_until: Wait till {{time}} if you can; rain eases by then
commute.leave_by: Leave by {{time}} to beat the rain
commute.carry_gear: Carry rain gear; rain around your departure

reason.rip_low_tide: rip current risk near low tide

register.heading: Register
register.errorMessage: An error occurred during registration. Please try again.

google.needClientId: Google sign-in needs a Client ID. Add
google.verifying: Verifying with Google — signing you in…
google.needsProfile: Google verified you, but your profile is incomplete. Please finish it below.
google.completeSub: Google verified {{email}}. Add the remaining details to finish signup — no password needed.
